answer: Because the timing is recorded against the signal challenge, the plume audit can replay the dune history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 272 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 1001 identities would post 3322 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
